description: Follow Great Britain's electricity market with Elexon's Balancing Mechanism Reporting Service (BMRS). See the live generation mix and generation by fuel, interconnector flows, wind and solar output and forecasts; demand, daily peaks and the demand forecasts; imbalance and market index prices, grid frequency and temperature; system warnings and REMIT outage messages; and each Balancing Mechanism unit's notifications and bids. Start workflows on new system warnings and REMIT messages. Everything reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
